name: timm (ResNet-18 / Fashion-MNIST)

patch.summary: +247/-2 across 10 files. Only three touch timm source: timm/data/loader.py (+5/-1) fixes a real bug - persistent_workers was forwarded unconditionally to DataLoader, so the documented -j 0 / --workers 0 single-process path raised ValueError before the first batch, in both train.py and validate.py; train.py (+3) and timm/utils/checkpoint_saver.py (+13) add an opt-in --save-last-only that leaves one checkpoint instead of three os.link() hardlinks to the same inode. Zero lines of the model definition, optimizer, scheduler or training loop were changed. The remaining +226 is added material: the treqs workflow, a dataset-fetch script, reproduction/README.md, .gitignore and three .gitkeep files.

summary: Truncated reproduction of the timm training path: ResNet-18 (11.2M params) trained from scratch on Fashion-MNIST at 28x28 single-channel for 5 epochs at batch 256 with timm's own train.py, then scored by timm's own validate.py on the 10k held-out split - held-out top-1 85.67 / top-5 99.73 against the exact checkpoint that was published. Not converged, and not offered as a timm result. Tier-1 record is green: clean DAG 13/13, AI-BOM 100/100, all URLs public, 57 portable pins with no local-version (+cu) pins. The standout finding is that timm's declared dependency set is honest - a fresh clone plus exactly the six packages in requirements.txt, with PYTHONPATH unset, ran all three steps to completion on CPU with nothing added by hand, which is the cleanest bare-clone result in the campaign so far. Two upstream defects were hit: create_loader() forwards persistent_workers=True unconditionally, so the documented --workers 0 single-process loading raises ValueError before the first batch (one-expression fix, patch included); and --in-chans 1 leaves mean/std at 3-channel ImageNet defaults, so a grayscale run dies broadcasting [3,28,28] onto [1,28,28] unless --mean/--std are passed explicitly. Separately, CheckpointSaver's three checkpoint names are os.link() hardlinks to one inode - byte-identical by design, so a content-addressed view showing three paths and one hash is timm working correctly, not a recording fault. Training is not bit-reproducible on GPU at --seed 42 alone (cuDNN algorithm selection is unpinned; timm exposes no --deterministic), so we claim reproduce, not replicate.
